features.context: actual interval/availability/trading and wall time/quality masks; not prediction targets
features.normalization: per-token same-period prior64-valid-return RMS with train-fitted floor and cold fallback; full warmup support counted; train-only field/period scale

If a specific deficit motivates an input trial, match raw history, initialization/warmup support, training budget and held-out uses across arms with and without that indicator.

audited_source_columns.later_deliveries: Inventory supplied and derived indicator fields, source/inputs, warmup, availability and role. The current encoder uses the nine declared numerical fields plus context and flags. Extra EMA/RSI/MACD inputs remain conditional F12.

input.unknown: zero with nonvisible flag; artificial dependence includes fallback-recomputed fields
input.artificial_flags_current: zero on full inputs; masked inputs mark every affected field from raw-minute support before computing aggregates, scales, first Value and P3 summaries
input.embedding_sum: Linear(28,768)(numeric and flags) + Linear(64,768)(GELU(Linear(8,64)(time/coverage))) + period embedding; no row-index positional embedding. Append one learned terminal state.

backbone.block_order: For X [B,T,768], Q,K,V project from tokenwise LN(X) then split to [B,12,T,64]. Y=X+Wout(concat(A @ mixed V)); Xnext=Y+Linear(3072,768)(GELU(Linear(768,3072)(LN(Y)))). Six blocks, final LN on terminal h, then P2 or P3 packing.
backbone.attention_permission: Market query may read valid available market keys with availability<=own, including co-closed scales; never terminal. Terminal reads all available market keys and itself. Padding keys excluded; skip or zero padding queries to avoid all-masked softmax. Each endpoint recomputes its own state.

relation.state_interval: no physical interval: duration/overlap/containment0, separate type indicators
relation.signed_gap_contract: nonnegative gaps on legal edges; if full matrix evaluated use sign(x)*log1p(abs(x)), no log1p of raw negative gaps
relation.score_contract: A = row softmax(Q K.T / 8 + 2*tanh(MLP_layer(phi)) + availability mask). One head coordinate per output, zero both final weight and bias; state key bias 0 does not remove legal terminal self-content.
relation.value_contract: Layer 1 uses its own V1 from normalized per-token input, before cross-bar mixing. Layers 2-6 use Vtilde_market=(1-sigmoid(a_lh))*V_l + sigmoid(a_lh)*V1, a_lh initially zero, differentiable path to the first Value projection; a terminal key uses current V. Common mask and per-view cleaned source in masked training.
relation.state_pair_fill: Terminal query ends at t; terminal own duration/coverage zero, pairwise duration ratio/IoU/contains zero if either is terminal; real counterpart duration and coverage retained. Keys of terminal type always get zero relation bias.
relation.hidden_activation: GELU for the two-layer relation MLP; architecture-document proposal for both arms, not a released implementation.
relation.score_effect_and_initial_gradient: On a common legal row, fixing Q and K multiplies a pair's odds by exp(b_j-b_k), within [exp(-4),exp(4)]. At initialization b=0, gradient can update the final affine projection; gradient into the preceding relation hidden layer is zero on that first backward pass.
relation.parameter_reporting_scope: Analytic parameter counts assume biased affine projections. Actual parameter accounting, FLOPs, memory and latency await implementation.

dense_hidden_cost.scope: One materialized dense pairwise relation hidden activation only, not measured total memory. If query-row tiling is used, retain every legal key and first-layer Value for each row. Verify outputs/gradients against dense on a small input and measure backward retention or recompute at preflight.

decoder.anchor_boundary: a=0 for query ending t, not scored; no true neighbor or per-query true sigma
decoder.query_phase: calendar ordinal within the past block, chronological j=0..15; current phase=(0,0). Lookup uses same prelocked calendar both arms.

block_execution.condition: Independent per-block Linear(768,512)(z_cond) -> gamma, beta [B,1,256], broadcast across K; z_cond=h for P2 or train-scaled FiLM copy for P3. Nonzero random conditioning weights.
block_execution.inside: Affine LN along final 256 on each query, modulate by (1+gamma) and beta, biased 256->256 Linear, GELU, biased 256->256 Linear, add original u. Distinct weights in four blocks; share across all queries/resolutions within an arm.
block_execution.out: Biased Linear(256,7) after block 4; relative close, body, upper/lower wick, log1p of V/startOI/endOI. Current close coordinate a=0; differences are computed from predictions. Absolute prices use C_t strictly for restoration.
block_execution.query_contract: Direct P2/invalid/current per-query; P3 valid past gathers a canonical chronological group of 16, projects using raw facts from z, then selects requested slots. Singleton/permuted/duplicate queries have the same answer up to numerical tolerance.
block_execution.open: Zero-capable/nonnegative direct-output transform, exp range, precision and physical thresholds are finalized in the release card.

decoder.tasks: One independently trained D per arm and seed, shared by clean and masked historical queries. Four FiLM blocks in series followed by ONE seven-field output. A is a separate direct current-description head.

matrix.description_head_loss: A receives 0.10 L_desc from clean z only.

matrix.structure: common backbone, fixed160+learned608, same FiLM then block adjustment

current_plan.comparison_scope: Whole memory allocation and corresponding readout under identical three-task training, paired initializations and task draws. With no clean-only arm this comparison cannot isolate the benefit of multitask training.

loss.invalid_terms: Normalize supported terms at each endpoint using the full label support before sampling. Remove zero-mass leaves and renormalize nominal weights over remaining siblings within the field, content-group and past/current hierarchy. No supported leaf: coverage only. Never redefine support by the sampled hits or P3 block validity.
loss.P3_gradients: Price I-UU.T on complete blocks, physical-simplex and OI-boundary derivatives piecewise; losses only on preselected weighted queries and true adjacency. Invalid/current direct.
loss.task_reduction: mean separately across 32 clean, 16 masked, 16 description samples then weight task means; nested clean groups sum to one inside L_clean
loss.coefficient_status: proposal to lock before observing candidate scores
loss.description: 18 equally weighted training-scaled SmoothL1 beta1 values per clean description example

sampling.rho: uniform eligible product -> uniform contract -> uniform nonempty year-month -> uniform endpoint
sampling.query_estimator: 64 independent draws with replacement from w per endpoint, identical for paired arms. For each positive-mass term f average m_if*loss_if/Z_f over these draws, with Z_f=sum_i w_i*m_if fixed from the full query list. Zero contribution for invalid draws, no second factor w and no random denominator. Repeated draws retain multiplicity even if forwards are deduplicated.
sampling.current_queries: Enumerate all legal intervals ending at t (up to 4); equal weight within each supported field. Apply the same fixed sibling normalization to active fields/groups.
sampling.adjacent: Assign a strictly-past change to its later query, append the immediately preceding calendar slot of the same period within the observed input. Require both valid closes and a proven consecutive link. Use predicted differences. No jumping over missing slots.
sampling.evaluation: all declared legal intervals at fixed endpoints, separately current/age/view/field
sampling.within_age_group: Uniform across eligible scheduled positions with at least one valid historical supervision term. Build w from the nonempty views/age groups, independently of the arm.
sampling.field_exposure: Report term coverage, realized exposure and the per-endpoint probability (1-Z_f)^64 of missing the term in all draws.
sampling.task_distribution: For support S_k and group-balanced base endpoint law rho, use rho(t)*1[t in S_k] / sum_s rho(s)*1[s in S_k]. Freeze each support, report its product/time coverage and exposure; legal endpoints may appear across pools. The 64-query law applies only to clean history.

mask.history: P1 used joint historical objectives in the 76b6ad2 design; both arms now use masked history in every update, superseding the unexecuted clean-only P2/P3 protocol at 8a15f57c6e1780e97b3cb17d236593d416aad87a.

source_mask.sampling: Uniform legal unordered nonoverlapping pairs of continuous segments within qualified trading sessions, strictly before t; keep the current anchor visible.

active_design.targets: 16 hidden past 1-minute intervals, equal across prequalified targets. Price/shape/activity weights as current_plan.loss.past_groups, valid terms fixed before sampling; truth enters loss only. Attribute an adjacent change to its hidden later query; append a qualified preceding query only for that difference. Average supported hidden positions within each field then renormalize supported siblings. Predeclare support using availability and calendar, independent of hidden market values.
active_design.dependency_closure: Apply mask to raw-minute dependencies before deriving views. Propagate to affected OHLCV/OI aggregates, preceding-close links, rolling scales, flags and readable metadata. Fixed train fallback where required. Recompute P3 facts from masked visible input only: invalid block = four zeros and flag 0, direct readout. Counterfactual hidden-value changes under fixed visible history/mask/eligibility preserve masked input, flags, summaries and decoder metadata. All market Values originate in this view, including first-layer Value. An observed later interval up to t may be used after removing hidden dependencies; target-side prior close is never provided as an input.
active_design.evaluation: On held-out eligible endpoints use paired, fixed masks; report per-field and per-session error, coverage and cost separately from R/U. Multiple true missing paths can give the same masked view.

price_reference.inputs: Only minute closes in the masked view recoverable in the declared common price coordinate. Same held-out endpoint, mask and target as both arms.
price_reference.estimate: Interpolate log close by trading-minute distance between the nearest certified observed closes bracketing the hidden span. With a single available side use its nearest certified close. With no support report unavailable. Compare on common support and disclose coverage separately from clean R.

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: 5% linear warmup then cosine to10%peak; one scheduler step per optimizer update
optimizer.precision: uniform BF16 only if device/numeric qualified; critical targets/metrics sufficient precision
optimizer.limits: AdamW decoupled parameter shrinkage not global optimum guarantee; record g_task dot actual_delta_theta alongside gradient cosines, with first-order/remainder limits
optimizer.decay_groups: matrices and learned embeddings decay; biases, norm and alpha scalars no decay
optimizer.gradient_accumulation: Accumulate on unchanged E/D/A parameters, weighing each clean example by 1/32, each masked by .25/16, each description by .10/16. Clip each of E,D,A at norm 1 after complete gradient accumulation, then one AdamW and one scheduler step. A uses the main schedule.

split_proposal.development: 2025 through 2026-09-12 03:00 Asia/Shanghai inclusive by source minute start
split_proposal.qualification: current: all input/warmup/historical-query support within assigned partition; no future60 requirement. Later forecast uses separately locked label-support inventory; no train/stat/pretrain final holdout.
split_proposal.reporting: Report disjoint cells for previously seen instruments on final dates, held-out instruments on pre-final development dates, and their intersection (held-out instruments on final dates). Freeze cells in advance, never select on the held-out instruments, and avoid counting the intersection twice as evidence.
split_proposal.cutoff_applied: The sealed monthly index uses minute_start_local > cutoff for later_time and held_product_later_time. An equal minute start belongs to the development era. Purge whole input, warmup and label spans separately.
split_proposal.independence_status: Per-cell ground-truth counts and coverage were inspected. Historical exposure and the number of usable market-time blocks for each claim remain to be checked. Candidate outcomes have not been observed.

budget.meaning_of_current_head_fits: Seven fresh post-freeze fits; separate from the four A modules already inside the four main training runs.

matched: raw observations, total state FP32 words, query metadata and use-head side information
identical backbone, FiLM and description-head structures; paired initialization for homologous parameters; independent E/D/A parameters for each arm and seed
same task pools, endpoints, clean queries, mask positions, targets, weights, task counts, paired seeds and N optimizer updates
standardization, selection opportunity and frozen-use labels

mandatory within-block expansion/projection cost, actual gradient paths

history_evaluation.primary: deployed direct P2 vs deployed adjusted P3: whole-system fidelity
history_evaluation.R: Final decoder, one half standardized relative-close MSE and one half adjacent-return MSE on all common eligible queries. For each term use its own complete support and renormalize endpoint weights rho over endpoints supporting that term. Report both coverages; if either is globally empty, R is unavailable.
history_evaluation.conditional: Trigger only on development data when both paired seeds meet the predeclared relative R gain and delivery seed 42 exceeds the protected degradation on overall U or any descriptor family. Then four frozen states each fit one fresh direct D256 with common protocol, at most four; report separately. No final holdout trigger.
history_evaluation.coherence: same physical parent-child complete partitions on clean observed history; no latent equality or extra unobserved minute targets
history_evaluation.R_perp: mean ||(I-UU.T)(a_hat-a)||^2/(14*s_price_period^2) on common valid blocks only; average blocks within valid view, views within endpoint, then renormalize rho over endpoints with support. Coverage and invalids separately, all in R.
history_evaluation.conditional_seed_scope: For this development-only diagnostic, seed 42 and seed 43 must each improve R over their paired P2 by at least 5%, and seed 42 must exceed the degradation guard on overall U (>5%) or a family (>10%). The normal upgrade rule uses seed 43 for direction only. A near-zero baseline uses the separately predeclared absolute rule.
history_evaluation.observed_resolution_and_price_precision: Recover only observed closed intervals at the declared resolution, using common C_t only to restore absolute prices. Report error by lookback, field and period in bps/ticks, plus tail error. Technical shape landmarks at finer resolution require the corresponding ordered inputs; empirical tick-level accuracy has not been measured.

price_anchor_support.audit: Before scoring, certify known price-ratio paths to C_t using only shared visible gap/body ratios and proven same-source price boundaries across periods. A missing fine bar can be bridged by a qualified coarse view. A missing certificate flags unproven connectivity, not necessarily non-identifiability. The raw source supplies answers and checks only.
price_anchor_support.report: Use identical predeclared masks for both arms. Keep all eligible truth-labelled targets in R. Stratify relative-close coverage and physical errors by certified versus unproven link to C_t. In the latter, scores can include imputation. Internal block contrasts, local geometry and adjacent changes have their own support.
price_anchor_support.gap_classification: A scheduled break in the historical calendar preserves the link when the same-contract previous close and next open are known in comparable units: log(O_next/C_prev) records even a large reopening jump. If scheduled bars are missing, first check known same-source cross-resolution connections. An added ratio between observed endpoints is a separately labelled span, not a one-minute move or a continuous-volatility warmup observation. Leave missing interiors unknown and separate contracts or unresolved quote regimes.

history_evaluation.matched_pca_interpretation: History scores compare each state with its own deployed decoder. Claims about reusable learned coordinates also require the matched frozen order-readout protocol, as specified in acceptance.
history_evaluation.absolute_limit_source: Set absolute tolerances from the declared use and non-final qualification examples before candidate scores. The final holdouts only confirm the locked rules.

reconstruction_composition.condition: For the actually represented ordered history H and allowed side information M, D(z,M)=H implies f(D(z,M),M)=f(H,M) for every determined f on that support. Absolute price, arrival order and initial state must be available when f needs them.
reconstruction_composition.approximation: If max absolute log-close error <= epsilon over the same window including its start, max log drawdown error <= 2*epsilon. Extremum ordering need not be stable.
reconstruction_composition.comparison: Compare raw-rule truth, same-rule after complete-input reconstruction and direct A/fresh A-prime on common supported endpoints. At endpoint t use an observed close of the same contract at the declared resolution and comparable quote units. Both experimental arms receive the same new values and addresses at t. historical_segment_price_anchor.anchor: In a supported contiguous within-view run ending at s, store a_s=log(C_s/C_t) and a resolvable in-state range. Decode from the same z with the normal, block-adjusted preliminary p on both i and s: C_hat_i=C_t*exp(a_s+p_i-p_s). Use the decoded body and wicks for O,H,L. The uniform shift leaves internal differences and the two zero-mean P3 price facts of complete blocks inside that run unchanged.
historical_segment_price_anchor.packing: One bounded layout: concatenate public, chronological scheduled slot IDs per view; current caps total 512. A record is [first_slot,last_slot,anchor], with the last slot specifying s and invalid addresses -1 for empty. Three FP32 words = 12 bytes per contiguous within-view range. Arbitrary noncontiguous or multiview components can require multiple records. M hard records reduce learned capacity by 3M inside 768 words (P2-style 768-3M, P3-style 160 fixed plus 608-3M learned). Freeze feasible M on non-final qualification data. If over cap, prefer latest end, then finer view, then fixed slot order; other runs use their normal readout. No external range table, truth lookup or free anchor side channel.
historical_segment_price_anchor.absolute_interface: Relative anchors recover prices with the ordinary public C_t and declared address/quote metadata. For price-self-contained z, budget C_t inside z as well or encode absolute anchors for required components; use a documented price unit/scale. Accurate C_t and exactly representable integer tick differences on a verified common grid allow a tick-exact anchor; test serialization and decoding. FP32 log does not promise bit-exact quotes.
historical_segment_price_anchor.qualification: Tabulate scheduled breaks, missing minute interiors with and without a proven price link, anchored-range count and weighted coverage per view/product/time. Choose M before final data or candidate scores based on target use and coverage.

block_memory.slot_order: Enumerate exchange-calendar slots strictly ending before t from most recent; reserve maxima per view, do not extend the original observed caps (which include current); group consecutively. Chronological j=0..15 within group. Never compact missing slots.
block_memory.eligibility: Same contract, same qualified units, all 16 observed within shared input, reversible price/volume/OI features, 15 known consecutive same-period boundary-close links. Qualified calendar breaks and prescribed short session-tail intervals explicit. Current intervals always direct. For masked examples all requirements apply to the visible view after raw-minute dependency removal. Never reuse a complete-input fact or its eligibility.
block_memory.invalid: Four zero coordinates plus mask 0; all independently eligible observed targets remain in R and clean loss; report qualified fraction under fixed query measure per view, product, time and endpoint.
block_memory.calculation: Recover relative log close path by setting first close locally to zero and accumulating 15 observed gap + body log returns. Both columns have zero sum. Recover physical V/OI from only shared inputs and train constants. Raw-source oracle is qualification only.
block_memory.price_adjust: On a valid block use p+U(c-U.T p). With exact c and the same p the unweighted level-SSE gain is the squared coefficient error; with stored c=U.T a+eps, residual SSE in exact remaining arithmetic is ||(I-UU.T)(p-a)||²+||eps||². Adjacency, R, SmoothL1 and downstream results require separate measurement.
block_memory.volume_adjust: Invert stored S. If S=0 return zeros; otherwise Euclidean projection of preliminary physical volumes to nonnegative sum S: max(v-tau,0). Partial zeros allowed.
block_memory.oi_adjust: Delta inverse from z. Let p0,p1 be preliminary physical first open OI, last close OI. x=max(0,-Delta,(p0+p1-Delta)/2); endpoints x,x+Delta; other OI unchanged.
block_memory.read_contract: Always expand the same calendar block for a valid constrained query, discard unrequested outputs from loss; compute current boundaries separately and return raw head on invalid blocks. Aggregate OHLC only on exact nested physical supports for diagnosis, no hard equality across all resolutions.
block_memory.float_contract: Serialize raw c1,c2,log1p(S),asinh(Delta/s),valid flag as FP32. Set all five to zero on an invalid block. The FiLM conditioning copy scales four valid values by train-only period means and population SD floored at 1e-6, then forces invalids to zero and keeps mask. Where a period has no valid training block, switch off explicit block facts and calibration, retain eligible direct bar targets for both arms, and report this coverage. Deterministic projection always uses the raw state, without global LN. Lock numerical tolerances in physical units before scores.
block_memory.OI_scale: Per period max(1 physical contract unit, median nonzero absolute Delta among valid training blocks); all-zero eligible group falls back to 1. Only comparable qualified volumes/OI in contracts.
block_memory.duration_weighting: Equal ordinal slot weights including calendar-accepted short final session bars, not equal minute-duration weights.
block_memory.calendar_complete_block_ceiling: 32 allocated blocks. For input caps C_s, I_s=1 when a scheduled bar of that view closes at t. Strictly-past full-block ceiling is sum floor((C_s-I_s)/16) = 32-sum I_s. At minute endpoints the full-history calendar ceiling ranges from 28 to 31; actual valid counts can be lower, including zero. Report ceiling, realized valid count and reasons separately.
block_memory.common_input_check: On both clean and masked complete views, identical common visible inputs at the declared precision, availability, allowed anchor, train-only scales and calendar imply identical 160 serialized coordinates. Raw higher precision is available for source truth checks, not as extra representational input.

Construct integer-tick opposite-extremum-order paths on same context and schedule; accept only fully legal pairs with flipped 37-close label, identical full serialized 160 prefix and identical all coarse OHLCV/OI. Recompute full feature/warmup inputs; report supported endpoints and rejection reasons. Existing frozen probe, high-first scored higher=1, tie=.5, reverse=0. Any deterministic function of equal summaries ties. Report paired simultaneous-market-block interval and compare to .5 independent of the natural BA test. No extra fitting.

All three consecutive trading minutes observed active. Use max(other 35 closes)+one valid tick and min(other 35)-one valid tick, in opposite orders; recompute opens from prior closes and H/L from O/C for affected three minutes, other data and V/OI fixed. Enforce known tick/market limits and qualified support; skip unknowns. Reject on unequal 160 serialized coordinates, unequal parent observations or same order labels. At most one pair/endpoint.

order_blind_controls.definition: Ratio of expected energies, pooled sums before taking ratio. Preserve each real block's 15 signed increments and net displacement; uniform within-block permutation. gradient_check.method: rational arithmetic; three analytic derivatives matched exact symmetric differences of a scalar quadratic joint objective

drawdown_check.log_paths: four log closes on {-1,0,1} with independently chosen perturbations from the same set
drawdown_check.theorem: at most 2 times maximum absolute log-close error

requirements_fit_20261127.status: synthetic CPU arithmetic, no model or data-download use

ohlc_counterexample.close_paths: identical whole histories of closes and adjacent changes

requirements_fit_20261127.direction_threshold: Exhausted all 65 positive/negative counts with 64 equal-magnitude nonzero returns; threshold inclusion agrees with 3:1 total up/down travel. All-flat -> middle.

order_collision.synthetic_clock: 8400 successive 1-minute bars from a 100 boundary, no gaps; 5/15/60 grids end on multiples of their periods; t=8400. Abstract calendar for arithmetic only.
order_collision.closes: 100 throughout except t-50=102, t-49=98 and t-34,t-33 equal [101,99] or [99,101].
order_collision.bar_fields: Each O=previous close, H/L=max/min(O,C), unit V, start/end OI=100. All declared raw units are shared.
order_collision.physical_descriptors: Per horizon use consecutive differences of FP64 log closes, end minus start for net, accurate sums for absolute or squared returns, max past peak minus subsequent close including boundary, log1p total volume and zero transformed OI change. All 18 FP64 values agree.
order_collision.summary: Use existing 32 scheduled strictly-past 16-slot blocks, ordered by period then age, caps include t. Sum the price contrasts on cumulative within-block visible log gap plus body from a local zero, with log1p volume and transformed OI change. 28 valid blocks; 160 packed FP32 values agree.
order_collision.checksums_encoding: concatenated big-endian IEEE FP32 for facts, FP64 for physical descriptions in listed horizon/field order
order_collision.limitations: Does not estimate frequency in actual contracts, prove exact descriptor equality on natural pairs or measure a model.

findings.finding: 端点无未来与内部三角mask混写；相对t坐标、遮挡模式不保证内部token可跨端点复用。

findings.finding: 64个有效收益若跳过异常缺口或漏算边界，会改变支持；头侧信息范围易扩张。
findings.disposition: 64连续合格收益需要65个边界收盘；未知缺口fallback；禁止每query真实尺度作为旁路。

findings.finding: 旧日期与新分辨率不自动产生独立数据；窗口长度也不保证相关块独立。
